name: VPN Connection
description: Windows MDM settings in the VPN Connection category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Connection name
properties.description: This is a descriptive name for the VPN connection and will be displayed to end-users on their device.

properties.name: Connection type
properties.description: This is the type of VPN server you use in your company.

properties.name: Servers
properties.description: List of VPN servers. Exactly one needs to be marked as the default server.

properties.name: Use this VPN profile with a user/device scope
properties.description: This is the scope for whether the VPN Profile will be per user, or per device
